title: House and Cellar
author: Hazel Okonkwo
blurb: Edmund Dunmore, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
